summary: A Marylebone dental and aesthetics clinic appears to lose bookings to competing booking paths and thin proof.

findings.problem: The header Book Online appears to go to one booking system, the Invisalign Book Now to another, and Dermafacial Book Now to WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Three booking paths confuse patients and lose bookings.

findings.problem: Contact Us appears to open WhatsApp instead of showing the phone or email, and the phone number appears only in the footer.
findings.cost: Patients who prefer to call cannot find the number quickly.
findings.fix: A visible phone number in the header.

findings.problem: Text such as Use tab to navigate through the menu items and Thanks for submitting appears to be visible, and image labels appear as file names.
findings.cost: Leftover text makes the clinic look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean copy and proper image labels.

findings.problem: The Award winning claim appears alongside finalist badges, no reviews appear, and services appear as titles only with no prices.
findings.cost: Unclear claims and no proof weaken a premium positioning.
findings.fix: Accurate awards, reviews and starting prices.
